chapter: Louisville, Buck and the carnival years
title: His mother, sisters and religion in the family
summary: He praises his mother, whom he supported until her death, and tells of raising his sister's children and his differences with her family's faith.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

I remember when I was about a year and a half old, my mother hed me up in her arms, I remember telling her, 'Put me down, ma'am,' and I've been down ever since. She was always good to me though.
